title: アカデミックリーディング２
subtitle: Academic Reading 2
educationalGoal: Improve reading skills and develop a diverse perspective by reading academic level articles about global events and cultures. Be able to read texts, discuss content, and express personal opinions logically.
advice:
Reading is a core component of listening, speaking, and writing skills. The objective of this course is to improve all 4 skills through reading passages at an appropriate speed to understand the content.

The following topics will be covered: Unit 9: Who We Are.   Unit 10: Global Warming.   Unit 11: Incredible Insects.   Unit 12: Going to Extremes.   Extra readings will be distributed in class.

Active learning in English class includes presentations, Q&A sessions, pair-work, group work, and worksheets.

Preview: Read the story, check the content, pronunciation, vocabulary, and answer all of the questions in the textbook.

In class: Ask questions and solve any problems you have encountered during the preview.
Review: Check the content and pronunciation of the words in the story and memorize the vocabulary.
Use office hours to ask extra questions.

Plan and prepare for group presentations.
Make study plans throughout the semester.
requiredKnowledge:
Students must have a basic knowledge of grammar and vocabulary.
There will be daily quizzes.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the topic of the story in each unit.
Be able to understand the structure of paragraphs and stories.
Be able to read, listen, pronounce, and write the words in the story in each unit.
Be able to find specific infomation about each story using various reading skills at an appropriate speed.
Be able to understand the story and exchange opinions with other students.
Be able to give a presentation on the topic taught in each unit.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1. Be able to read and understand passages in the
   textbook at an appropriate speed.
2. Be able to understand, read, and pronounce the
   vocabulary in the textbook.
3. Autonomously research more about the topic taught in each unit and give presentations to teach others based on own research.
achievementLevels.standard:
1. Be able to read and understand passages in the
   textbook at an appropriate speed with 70% accuracy.
2. Be able to understand, read, and pronounce the
   vocabulary in the textbook with 70% accuracy.
3. Be able to give a presentation about the topic taught in each unit.
